deck.name: The Lowdown Moo Tube
deck.premise: Minotaur ('beef') tribal around Didgeridoo (Homelands, 1995): find the horn, blow the horn, make more beef, turn it sideways. Taken from the original Moxfield description.

mandatory_cards.rule: at least one tutor that can find Didgeridoo in every tier
mandatory_cards.tutor_definition: Didgeridoo tutor = a card whose Scryfall oracle text can get a noncreature artifact with mana cost {1} (Didgeridoo) from the library into hand, onto the battlefield, or onto the top of the library: any-card tutors (Demonic, Diabolic, Vampiric to the top, Gamble), artifact tutors (Reckless Handling, Inventors' Fair, which needs three or more artifacts), and Urza's Saga chapter III ({0}/{1} artifact onto the battlefield). Creature tutor = searches only for creature cards (Pyre of Heroes, Deathbellow War Cry, Citanul Flute); these can't find Didgeridoo and don't count toward the must-keep. Total tutors = Didgeridoo tutors + creature tutors. Verified against oracle text (scryfall_cards.json, 26 Oct 2026) and original.txt.

deck.classification_method: Hand-classified by function from Scryfall oracle text; a card may count in more than one bucket. Ramp = produces mana or reduces spell costs (rocks, mana creatures, cost reducers, Mana Echoes, Neheb the Eternal). Draw = net card advantage or repeatable card selection (draw spells, Phyrexian Arena, Necropotence, looters such as Glint-Horn/Neheb Dreadhorde/Hazoret's Monument, Herald's Horn, Vanquisher's Banner). Interaction = removes or neutralises opposing permanents/graveyards (removal spells, wipes, Bojuka Bog, repeatable damage/fight sources). Tutors are counted separately and split into Didgeridoo tutors and creature tutors (see tutor_definition). Lands = type line contains Land (MDFCs none).
deck.curve_method: Scryfall cmc of each nonland card (commander included), times quantity; 7+ bucketed.
deck.mandatory_cards_note: No single Didgeridoo tutor appears in all three tiers. Budget replaces the original's Demonic Tutor/Vampiric Tutor/Gamble/Urza's Saga/Inventors' Fair with Reckless Handling and Diabolic Tutor. Deathbellow War Cry is in every tier but is a creature tutor and not a must-keep.
deck.tutor_definition: Didgeridoo tutor = a card whose Scryfall oracle text can get a noncreature artifact with mana cost {1} (Didgeridoo) from the library into hand, onto the battlefield, or onto the top of the library: any-card tutors (Demonic, Diabolic, Vampiric to the top, Gamble), artifact tutors (Reckless Handling, Inventors' Fair, which needs three or more artifacts), and Urza's Saga chapter III ({0}/{1} artifact onto the battlefield). Creature tutor = searches only for creature cards (Pyre of Heroes, Deathbellow War Cry, Citanul Flute); these can't find Didgeridoo and don't count toward the must-keep. Total tutors = Didgeridoo tutors + creature tutors. Verified against oracle text (scryfall_cards.json, 26 Oct 2026) and original.txt.

budget.strategy: Budget Jank sticks to the bit: find Didgeridoo (Reckless Handling, Diabolic Tutor), drop Minotaurs from hand for {3}, and double each one with Sethron. Deathbellow War Cry fetches four Minotaurs, and Pyre of Heroes climbs the creature curve from nontoken creatures (a Sethron token is MV 0 and only reaches Universal Automaton). Hammer of Purphoros gives the herd haste. Win with Shared Animosity, Rage Reflection or Patriarch's Bidding alpha strikes, or with Sethron's menace/haste pump. Plenty of Homelands-era Anaba cards and the Hurloon cows (Hurloon Minotaur is a vanilla 2/3; Hurloon Shaman is a 2/3 with "When this creature dies, each player sacrifices a land of their choice.") for the old-school flavor.
editorial_notes: Official total $69.44 excluding basics ($71.60 with basics) at the listed printings, Scryfall 2026-10-29T19:20:16+09:00: under the $100 cap. Secondary note: Scryfall default printings were $102.72 on 2026-10-26, which would fail, so buyers must pick the listed printings.
Weakest at protecting Didgeridoo/Sethron; artifact removal is lethal to the plan.
Lowest power, most purely nostalgic: 4 Anaba cards plus Hurloon Minotaur/Shaman.

Reckless Handling discards a card at random after the search, so it can discard the Didgeridoo it just found. With only 2 Didgeridoo tutors, this is the tier most exposed to that risk (ISS-011). Fixing it would need a swap; none was made.
Pyre of Heroes: starting from a Sethron token (MV 0), the only MV-1 target is Universal Automaton. Its main role is climbing from nontoken creatures (ISS-012).

maximum.strategy: Maximum Jank turns the horn into an engine: Didgeridoo plus Rings of Brighthearth, Cryptic Gateway, Mana Echoes refunds, and Panharmonicon and Roaming Throne doubling Sethron. Conspiracy naming Minotaur makes your creatures and creature cards Minotaurs, so Didgeridoo can put any creature card from hand onto the battlefield. It finishes with Coat of Arms, Kindred Charge, Molten Echoes or Soul Burn, and adds an Ice Age 1995 package (Necropotence, Hecatomb, Soul Burn, Game of Chaos) plus Krark's Thumb (Mirrodin 2003) and Karplusan Minotaur (Coldsnap 2006) for coin flips.
